steps.action: A module-only form leaves the type to Legal at conversion
steps.actual: R-27 used the module-only form. Triage offered ["Convert to contract","Convert to matter","Resolve request without converting"] and the dialog explained "This request type left the matter type to conversion." with a real Matter type picker (options start ["Type…","Employment","Litigation","Regulatory"]). Choosing "Ind template type IND81T2F" created Matter 32 of that type.

steps.action: A No target form is answered in the thread, and converting one is a deliberate re-target
steps.actual: R-28 used the No target form. Its Request page reads Converts to "No target" and Triage offers ["Convert to contract","Convert to matter","Resolve request without converting"]. The Settings explanation is "Converting a request of this type creates no record. It is answered in the thread and resolved there.". Opening Convert to matter shows the re-target note "This request type does not target a matter. Converting it to one is a re-target, and the request itself is kept." and a Matter type picker (1), so a destination is chosen only by a deliberate re-target rather than by the form leaving a module open.

steps.action: An archived configured target needs a deliberate live choice at conversion
steps.actual: After archiving the bound Contract type "NDA", the request type's Target control still names it as "NDA (archived)" (value contract:019ff1f5-301d-7795-a5af-e4339c76d4ce). Converting R-29 no longer confirms a bound type: the dialog now shows a live Contract type picker (1) with the note "This request type left the contract type to conversion." and its confirm control disabled=false until a live type is chosen. Nothing switched module on its own. Restore returned the type to the live list.
